title: Example of overriding createURL for connectMultiRange
body:
as default, it creates a query param like `?date_created=1485878400%3A1488297599`
do we have any way to use label as query param? `?date_created=Today`

comments.body: Hi @vinhlh thanks for opening this issue. It is not possible to override the way the state values are serialized in the URL.
@vinhlh Is it related to instantsearch.js or react-instantsearch? :D

React InstantSearch has been moved here: https://github.com/algolia/react-instantsearch
This issue has either been rewritten or placed inside our backlog.
